title: Dyadic auxiliary-unit quadratic projector
statement: For A=(Z/8Z)^x written as a=3^u 5^v and chi_8(a)=(-1)^(u+v), the phase Q_D(u,v)=chi_8(a) zeta_8^((a-1)D) has polarization (-1)^(D u u'), and summing the unnormalized phases gives 2(zeta_8-zeta_8^3)chi_8(D) for every D modulo eight. For odd D the radical has size two and Q_D is trivial on it; for even D the quadratic Gauss sum is zero.

evidence.supports: All eight residues and all sixteen polarization pairs per residue satisfy the exact cyclotomic, bilinear, radical, and phase-restriction identities.
evidence.notes: The checker uses integer coordinates in Z[zeta_8] reduced by zeta_8^4=-1; no floating-point roots of unity are used.

notes: This settles the auxiliary projector only. It does not establish a group law mixing the affine inverse fibres, valuation layers, and Witt coordinates, and it does not bound the endpoint trace.
